summary: SiliconFlow grants $1 in free credits at signup for its serverless inference platform (LLM, image, video, audio models), with postpaid pay-as-you-go billing and no minimum commitments. Complements the separate siliconflow-free-models offer, which tracks SiliconFlow's permanently free model list.
claim_steps: $1 in free credits is granted to get started; no minimum commitment.
Selected models are also permanently free — see the pricing page's free entries.

social_proof.title: Pricing Plans - SiliconFlow
social_proof.text: Flexible token pricing, high usage limits, and postpaid billing—plus $1 in free credits to get you started! There are no minimum commitments. You only pay for what you use, and you can start with $1 in free credits.
